rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent linear bar with a carved internal void and a cantilevered/extended end, so it has a legible dominant gesture and a meaningful public-space figure. However, the stepped/terraced roofline is not yet convincing as a program-supporting section for neighborhood living; it currently feels more like an abstract slice/cascade than an active mixed-use ground-to-upper hierarchy. The mass appears coherent in the provided views, but the silhouette is still somewhat repetitive and thin, and the section does not clearly communicate a strong inhabitable upper logic or daylight/public threshold beyond the carve. Access response is present through the void, but it is not yet sufficiently emphatic to fully satisfy the brief.
